title: Checking a restored photo library
content_html:
A restore exercise should open the application as well as check the archive. Restore the database and photo library into a separate instance before replacing working data.

Verify an older photo, a recent upload, and the associated metadata after signing in. Keep the original application running separately while checking the restored copy.

title: Watching the age of a scheduled scan
content_html:
A failed scan should retain the previous complete findings and report its own failure. Record the last successful scan time separately from the number of vulnerabilities found.

A freshness alert can catch a timer that silently stopped running after a configuration change. Test the alert with a disposable target before connecting it to your normal notification channel.
